messages:
Jess (PM): quick sync — we need to lock launch gating for the new sequenced+parallel tool-calling API. customers asking for multi-step chains that mix fanout + ordered steps. who can summarize must-have vs nice-to-have?
Matt (Eng): must-have: clear ordering semantics, per-call timeouts, idempotency tokens for retries. nice-to-have: automatic dependency inference.
Ada (DevEx): ergonomics matter — SDK should support both a simple `instructions` mode and an explicit `call_plan`. simplest surface for 90% of users: `calls: [{tool, input}]` with optional `depends_on` and `mode: parallel|sequential`.
Sam (Infra): perf constraints — for MVP we should cap concurrent fanout to 3 per request to avoid noisy neighbors. also need a global request timeout (suggest 10s) and per-tool timeout override.
Carlos (SRE): retry rules: client-visible idempotency key, server-side limited retries only for idempotent tools, exponential backoff, and a retry budget per session. must add observability: per-tool latency + failure counters.
Matt (Eng): high-level API sketch:```json
{
  "call_plan": [
    {"id":"s1","tool":"web_search","mode":"parallel","timeout_ms":3000},
    {"id":"s2","tool":"summarize","depends_on":["s1"],"mode":"sequential"}
  ],
  "global_timeout_ms":10000,
  "idempotency_key":"<uuid>"
}
```Ada (DevEx): love the sketch. add convenience: `auto_merge_results: bool` and `structured_output_schema` for downstream parsing. default should be not to merge to avoid accidental loss of sources.
Jess (PM): launch criteria proposal: (1) API contract doc + SDK examples (JS/Python), (2) 3 beta customers (internal or partner) using >1 tool per request, (3) perf targets: p95 end-to-end <= 800ms when fanout=1, <=1200ms fanout=3 in our hosted region, (4) alerts for per-tool error rate >1% and degraded throughput.
Sam (Infra): infra checklist: quota controls for concurrent fanout, backpressure when GPU pool saturated, metrics pipeline updates, and an e2e chaos test for tool failures.
Carlos (SRE): also require determinism test for ordering: given same call_plan+inputs we should have reproducible ordering of tool invocations unless `nondeterministic: true` is set.
Matt (Eng): open questions: 1) do we allow partial success semantics (return partial results + explicit fail reason) or always rollback? MVP: return partial + explicit per-call status. 2) orchestration location: control-plane vs runtime — MVP keep orchestration in runtime for latency.
Jess (PM): decision draft: MVP ship with modes: `sequential`, `parallel(fanout<=3)`, and `hybrid` (explicit depends_on). defaults: global_timeout_ms=10000, per-tool timeout optional, idempotency_key required for retries. partial results allowed. SDKs expose `call_plan` + `convenience` builder.
Ada (DevEx): docs + examples owner: Ada. ETA for beta docs: 2 weeks.
Matt (Eng): runtime owner: Matt. ETA for v1 spec + tests: 3 weeks.
Sam (Infra): infra owner: Sam. Will add quota + metrics by EOW.
Carlos (SRE): I'll add SLOs + alert rules to the runbook.
